mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY growth is below -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) YoY growth is below 2%, the real interest rate is positive, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.5% in a month and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and PAYEMS decreases
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and PAYEMS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing sector, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth is positive and GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, it signals a supply-side driven economy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased productivity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO growth is positive and GDPC1 growth is negative.
